_document.title: MLLDE xAPI IRI Registry — unified identifiers for CEFR skills, subskills and measurement concepts
_document.status: Early design draft. Superseded by the published canonical registry at https://profeanaeslavaedtech.github.io/mllde-xapi/ (measurement model v0.8.3). Content inventory versions separately at v0.7.1. See that page for the authoritative IRI set.
_document.researchFinding: No official IRI vocabulary exists for CEFR skills, subskills or mediation (Council of Europe publishes descriptors as documents, not linked data). No language-learning xAPI profile exists in ADL's authored-profiles registry. Therefore MLLDE mints its own namespace, reusing established generic IRIs where semantics match, and records alignments to CEFR Companion Volume scales and ESCO/Europass as metadata.

_namespacePolicy.rationale: w3id.org is the free, community-run persistent-identifier service used by modern xAPI profiles (audio, cmi5, seriousgames all live under w3id.org/xapi/). Registering w3id.org/mllde is a single GitHub pull request, filed from the profeanaeslavaedtech GitHub account, and keeps IRIs stable even if a personal domain lapses.
rules: Reuse-first: if an established IRI (ADL, w3id profile) matches the meaning exactly, reuse it; never mint a duplicate.
One concept, one IRI: every skill, subskill scale, level, rubric category, extension, verb, incident type and pedagogical action has exactly one distinct IRI.
IRIs are identifiers, not links: they never need to resolve to a webpage, but each SHOULD eventually resolve to human-readable documentation.
Extension values are IRIs from this registry (e.g. cefr-level extension carries https://w3id.org/mllde/cefr/level/b1), so any LRS can interpret statements without MLLDE documentation at hand.

alignmentReferences.note: ESCO language skills are per-language UUID URIs referencing CEFR in prose; useful as alignment metadata for HR/admin reporting (persona 3), not usable as skill/subskill identifiers in statements.

skills.label: Mediation
skills.note: MLLDE fifth skill (decision 2026-08-04): mediation output is realised through the oral or written channel; statements carry both the mediation scale IRI and the output-channel skill IRI.

subskillScales._note: One IRI per CEFR Companion Volume descriptor scale, grouped by MLLDE skill. 'cvScale' is the scale's name in the Companion Volume (2020) for traceability.

listening.cvScale: Understanding as a member of a live audience
Understanding audio (or signed) media and recordings

speaking.note: The Voicemode service-encounter mission maps here.
CV replaced the 2001 phonology scale; anchor for GOP metrics.
Anchor for per-phoneme (IPA) scoring — evidence tier 3 until GOP is built.
Stress, rhythm, intonation — kept as separate metric lines, never folded into phoneme scores.

writing.note: CV online-interaction scale; chat-based lessons map here.

mediation.cvScale: Relaying specific information (in speech or writing)
Explaining data, e.g. in graphs, diagrams, charts (in speech or writing)
Translating a written text (in speech or writing)
Expressing a personal response to creative texts
Analysis and criticism of creative texts
Acting as intermediary in informal situations
Facilitating communication in delicate situations and disagreements

reused.use: Performance meets the level's can-do descriptors (rubric floors met)
Attempt did not yet meet floors (non-punitive: pairs with unlimited retry)
Band or subskill progression event (e.g. B1 → B2 readiness signal)
A conversational turn in interaction scales
Optional, listening media events (ADL audio profile)

minted.label: pronounced
minted.definition: Made a pronunciation attempt at a declared target feature (phoneme, stress, intonation). Result carries phoneme-scores and/or model-imitation outcome.

minted.label: mediated
minted.definition: Performed a mediation activity: transformed or relayed content from a source for a recipient. Context carries the mediation scale IRI and the output-channel skill IRI.

minted.label: adapted
minted.definition: Actor is the teaching agent (human or AI): the learning path or assessment was adapted for the learner. Context carries the pedagogical-action IRI and the evidence that motivated it.

minted.label: Mission / authentic task
minted.note: The unit of authentic assessment (service encounter, negotiation…). Candidate to align with the ADL seriousgames profile — verify overlap on packaging.

minted.label: Pronunciation drill (Notice → Model → Invite → Move on)
Single spoken turn
minted.note: Granularity for turn-level telemetry (latency, ASR confidence)

context.value: IRI from subskillScales — the specific Companion Volume descriptor scale the activity evidences
oral | written — required for mediation statements
Identifier of the active instance/city module (engine + pack architecture)
IRI from evidenceTiers — the confidence tier of the measurement in this statement
IRI from pedagogicalActions — how the teaching side responded (the 'recorded pedagogy, not just performance' stream)
Object: what was asked + resolution strategy (defined-in-target-language, gloss, example…)
voice | text — modality of the scored production; lets the ASR 0.70 gate apply to voice only (typed/OCR scores without the gate). Added v0.8.3.
String/id — the model that scored this session; kept for comparability and governance (sessions by different models are not mixed). Added v0.8.1.

result.value: Object keyed by rubricCategories IRIs, integer bands 0–10 read against the level descriptor (pass = band ≥ 6; floors intelligibility AND interaction ≥ 4). Cambridge 0–5 view = round(band/2), a reporting lens only. (Corrected from the earlier 1–3 draft wording.)

Array of { ipa: string (broad transcription), score: 0–100, confidence: 0–1, acceptedVariants: [ipa] } — acceptedVariants encodes legitimate variation (e.g. seseo/distinción); tier 3 until GOP or vendor scorer is integrated
0–1 transcript confidence for the scored audio
Milliseconds from prompt end to learner speech onset — cognitive-load proxy
Retry count to completion (non-punitive mastery loop)

incident.value: Object: change made + date + post-change rate — the resolution ledger for the admin improvement loop

pedagogicalActions.label: Implicit recast — correct by modelling, flow preserved
Scaffold — graded hint, never the full answer first

evidenceTiers.label: Tier 1 — task gates, retries, rubric bands, help requests
Tier 2 — requires instrumentation: latency, ASR-confidence-weighted scores, vendor pronunciation APIs over an IPA-coded inventory
Tier 3 — per-phoneme phonological control pending the GOP build (open research piece)
